description: [Increment 1: Assumptions] Chapter 1: Wstęp, Cel i Teza Pracy — Introduction, aim of the work, thesis statement and success criteria in thesis.md
[Increment 1: Assumptions] Chapter 2: Stan Badań i Przegląd Literatury — Theoretical foundations of MDPs, Q-Learning algorithm and related work in thesis.md
[Increment 1: Assumptions] Configuration module with experiment parameters (learning rate, epsilon, epochs, seeds) in ttt_config.py
[Increment 1: Assumptions] Game logic module implementing Tic-Tac-Toe board state, move validation and win checking in ttt_env.py. Includes `get_random_move` helper for baseline opponent simulation.
[Increment 2: Method] Unit tests for ttt_env.Board (reset, move, is_terminal, check_win) and get_random_move in tests/test_ttt_env.py
[Increment 2: Method] Agent module implementing Tabular Q-Learning with epsilon-greedy policy in ttt_agent.py. Uses `Board.step(action)` where action is by current player.
[Increment 2: Method] Unit tests for ttt_agent.Agent (reset, step, get_q_values, choose_action) in tests/test_ttt_agent.py
[Increment 2: Method] Chapter 3: Metodyka — Methodology describing the Q-Learning agent design, environment interaction and epsilon-greedy strategy in thesis.md

[Increment 3: Experiment] Experiment entrypoint running training of Q-Learning against random opponent, computing win/draw/loss rates over TEST_EPISODES, and saving results to CSV in ttt_experiment.py
[Increment 3: Experiment] Chapter 4: Eksperyment — Experimental setup, parameters, and justification of evaluation metrics in thesis.md
[Increment 3: Experiment] Chapter 5: Wyniki — Results analysis comparing Q-Learning performance against random baseline in thesis.md
[Increment 3: Experiment] Chapter 6: Podsumowanie — Conclusions and future work in thesis.md

[Repair] Fix ttt_env.py: implement Board class matching interface (reset returns self, step calculates player correctly, get_winner checks all lines). Previous attempts failed because reset did not return self explicitly in some versions or logic for current player was flawed. Ensure doctests pass: `b.reset()` result is assigned to `_`, `b.is_terminal()` is False initially.

[Repair] Fix ttt_agent.py: implement Agent class matching interface (Q-learning update rule, epsilon-greedy choice). Previous attempts failed due to `ANSWER_REJECTED` shape mismatch and logic errors in `decay_epsilon`. Ensure `get_q_values` returns list of floats, `choose_action` respects legal moves, `update` applies RL formula correctly. Do not use numpy to avoid import/shape issues if standard library is preferred; stick to pure Python lists/dicts as per interface hints.

[Increment 1: Assumptions] Chapter 1: Wstęp, Cel i Teza Pracy — Introduction, problem definition (MDP), thesis statement and success criteria in thesis.md. Focus on Tic-Tac-Toe as a deterministic, fully observable MDP.

[Increment 1: Assumptions] Chapter 2: Stan Badań i Przegląd Literatury — Theoretical foundations of MDPs, Q-Learning algorithm (Bellman equation), and related work on Tic-Tac-Toe solvers in thesis.md.

[Increment 2: Method] Chapter 3: Metodyka — Methodology describing the Q-Learning agent design, environment interaction and epsilon-greedy strategy in thesis.md. Reference `ttt_agent.py` and `ttt_env.py` interfaces.
